text:
incident-bot: PAGE: gpu-pool-exhausted in gcp-mexico-central1 - multiple alloc failures for serving-pool-3, queue growth > 2k, severity: P1 :rotating_light:
carla: seeing huge enqueue rate from batch-ingest. dashboard shows sustained 95% GPU utilization across the pool, autoscaler attempted scale-up but kept failing with quota errors
alice: stacktrace from autoscaler: `ErrProvision: API quotaExceeded: region 'mexico-central1' has 0 available GPUs for project rwd-inference-prod`
mike: reassigning oncall, taking initial triage — I'll gather impact numbers and start customer notif if needed
oncall-mle: taking. quick question: do we have warm pool capacity in any nearby region we can failover to?
carla: eu-west3 warmpool has spare 8 nodes but latency jump for affected customers. some internal routes allow cross-region fallback for low-priority jobs only
ben: confirmed: cloud console shows soft limit at 40 GPUs, current requested would push to 44 and quota denied. No pending quota requests in queue
sre-notify-bot: Incident runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota-exhaustion
carla: copying relevant logs for autoscaler: ```
2026-02-10T17:21:03Z autoscaler: request-gpus=4 -> quota denied (403)
2026-02-10T17:21:04Z provisioner: scale_attempt=7 region=gcp-mexico-central1 error=QuotaExceeded
2026-02-10T17:21:07Z queue: pending_jobs=2158 avg_wait=12.3s
```
alice: mitigation options: 1) immediate partial failover of non-urgent queues to eu-west3 2) reduce model concurrency on serving-pool-3 (lower throughput) 3) emergency quota request to GCP support (slow)
mike: I'll start partial failover for background jobs now. Carla can you throttle PLG burst routes?
carla: doing. Applying rate limit on /v1/generate routes for free-tier and trial tokens. Command: ```kubectl patch configmap rate-limits -p '{"data":{"plg-burst":"50r/s"}}' -n redwood-prod```
oncall-mle: starting failover: routing rule updated to send 'embed-batch' and 'async-ingest' to eu-west3 pool. Expect drop in pending by ~40% in 6-8m
ben: opened support case with GCP: case #CASE-20260210-459, selected "urgent quota increase"; ETA from GCP unknown
mike: customer impact check: public API latency spikes for synced requests, some 503s on heavy tenants. Internal dashboard flagged 27 customers with >5% error rates in last 5m
carla: posting a short customer status note draft: "We are experiencing capacity shortages in gcp-mexico-central1 causing higher latency for some workloads. We are failing non-critical workloads to nearby regions and throttling burst traffic while we work with cloud provider. More updates in 30m." Thoughts?
oncall-mle: go ahead, send to customersupport and status page. I'll add mitigation details and note the regions affected
alice: preparing temporary autoscaler patch to avoid repeated quota churn: if quota errors detected, autoscaler should backoff and mark region as throttled for 10m. Pushing a canary now. Patch snippet: ```if err == QuotaExceeded { markRegionThrottled(region, 600) }```
ben: approved, but remember this hides root cause; still need quota increase or capacity re-route for full recovery
mike: ops note: we've enabled fallback-model routing for high-priority tenants to lower-memory quantized variant in-region to reduce GPU footprint. This should reduce avg mem per replica by ~30%
carla: observing pending_jobs dropping to 1.4k after failover + throttles. avg_wait down to 6.7s. Errors for top tenants still at ~3%
oncall-mle: handing off to night oncall in 45m. Summary for handoff: region gcp-mexico-central1 hit quota, autoscaler received repeated QuotaExceeded errors, partial background job failover to eu-west3 done, PLG burst throttled, emergency GCP case opened, canary autoscaler backoff deployed, fallback-model routing enabled. Remaining work: follow up with GCP case, monitor queue and customer errors, consider requesting reserved capacity if this repeats
mike: tagging SRE pager and infra leads for follow up. @infra-leads please review quota request and consider reserved pool
ben: escalation note: if GCP can't expand quickly, propose migrating some reserved workloads to eu-west3 or add dedicated reserved capacity in a second region. I'll draft options and ROI
carla: quick link to logs/traces: https://observability.redwood/logs?query=gcp-mexico-central1%20QuotaExceeded
incident-bot: Incident update: severity remains P1. Next automated check in 5m. Runbook step executed: partial-failover (success), throttle-plg (success), quota-request (in-progress)
oncall-mle: thanks team. I'll stay until handoff. If error rate drops below 1% and queue <500, we'll close the pager. otherwise escalate to exec oncall for customer comms.
alice: note for postmortem: add telemetry to autoscaler to surface remaining available quota per region and a metric for repeated quota denials to trigger preemptive warmpool allocation
mike: agree. Also add a play to evaluate cross-region warmpool thresholds for high-burst regions
carla: last update before handoff: pending_jobs 410, avg_wait 1.9s, error_rate 0.8%. Moving to monitoring state. Handing to night shift.
oncall-mle: handoff complete — oncall-mle signing off, night-oncall take over. Good job everyone :clap:
